user.title: Authorize Quark Cloud Drive
user.description:
1. Open the link below in your browser:

[Open authorization link]({authorize_url})

2. Scan the QR code with the Quark Drive app and confirm

3. Paste the authorization code (starts with `AAC-`) you received below

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Quark Cloud Drive. Check your network and retry.
error.invalid_auth_code: The authorization code is invalid. Scan again to get a new one; codes can only be used once.
error.expired: The authorization code has expired. Scan again to get a new one.
error.already_authorized: This account is already authorized for this device. Revoke the authorization in the Quark app (Me → Login authorization management) or remove and re-add this integration entry.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Quark Cloud Drive instance can be configured.

download_size_limit.message: The Quark open platform limits API downloads to {limit_mb}MB per file; this backup ({size_mb}MB) cannot be restored via API. Download it manually from the Quark Drive web/app, or reduce the backup size.

upload_capacity_limit.message: Quark Cloud Drive is full; this backup ({size_mb}MB) cannot be uploaded. Free up space or upgrade your plan, then retry.

download_no_url.message: The server returned no download url
